page.title: What’s new
page.markFailed: We couldn’t mark them as read. Check your connection and try again.
page.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your notifications. Check your connection and try again.
page.signedOut: Log in to see your notifications.

what.tagRejected: took a new tag off your story “{{title}}”: it wasn’t approved.
what.ageCheckDecided: checked your age by hand. See the result and the reason.
what.ageCheck18Invite: your year of birth now says you’re 18 or over. Confirm it with an ID document to get the settings for adults.
what.parentConsentAgreed: agreed. Your account is ready: you can now publish, comment, post and send messages.
what.parentConsentWithdrawn: withdrew their consent. Your account is read-only for now.
what.loginMethodAdded: a new way to log in was connected. If this wasn’t you, change your password and contact us.
what.loginMethodRemoved: a way to log in was disconnected. If this wasn’t you, change your password and contact us.
what.teacherCheckDecided: your Teacher badge request has an answer.
what.dataExportReady: your copy of your data is ready to download.
what.storiesExportReady: your stories are ready to download.
what.readingReminder: a few minutes of reading today?
what.storyFinished: finished {{story}} and says thank you for writing it.
what.spaceJoinApproved: you’re in {{space}}. You can now post there.
what.signatureChangeRequested: please change your forum signature within 24 hours, or it will be removed.
what.bannerChangeRequested: please change the banner picture of {{space}} within 24 hours, or it will be removed.
what.certificateIssued: your teacher signed a certificate for you in {{space}}. It’s in My certificates.
what.classArchived: the class space “{{space}}” is archived. Save your own copies of its certificates within 30 days: then the real names printed on them are deleted.
what.staffShowedStory: your story “{{story}}” can be found again.
what.staffPutBackPassage: we put back the passage we removed from chapter {{number}} of “{{story}}”.
what.staffShowedTitle: readers can see the title of your story “{{story}}” again.
what.staffShowedCover: readers can see the cover of your story “{{story}}” again.
what.dataRequestConfirm: we received a request about your data ({{reference}}) by email or post, not from inside your account. Was it you?
what.dataRequestExtended: we need more time to answer your data request {{reference}}. The new deadline and the reason are in Settings.
what.dataRequestCopyReady: your copy for the data request {{reference}} is ready. Download it in Settings within seven days.
what.pictureOpenedByStaff: opened the original file of an uploaded picture. Every opening is in the audit log.

decisions.no_action: a moderator checked a report about {{item}} and took no action, so nothing changes.
decisions.hide: a moderator hid {{item}} from other people.
decisions.remove: a moderator removed {{item}} because it breaks the rules.
decisions.restrict: a moderator limited who can see {{item}}.
decisions.warn: a moderator sent you a warning about {{item}}.
decisions.suspend: a moderator paused your account for a while. The decision is about {{item}}.
decisions.ban: a moderator closed your account. The decision is about {{item}}.
decisions.public_note: a moderator added a note to {{item}}.

empty.title: You’re all caught up
empty.body: New chapters, replies and follows will show up here.

decisionsCard.heading: Decisions about your posts
decisionsCard.body: When a moderator makes a decision about something you posted, you always hear about it here, with the reasons and how to challenge it. You can’t switch these off.

statementDecisions.hide: a moderator hid something you posted.
statementDecisions.remove: a moderator removed something you posted.
statementDecisions.restrict: a moderator limited who can see something you posted.
statementDecisions.warn: a moderator sent you a warning.
statementDecisions.suspend: a moderator paused your account for a while.
statementDecisions.public_note: a moderator added a note to your story.
statementDecisions.reporting_pause: a moderator paused your reports for a while.
statementDecisions.rating_raised: a moderator raised your story’s rating.
statementDecisions.ai_label_added: a moderator labelled your story as AI-written.
statementDecisions.title_hidden: a moderator hid your story’s title.
statementDecisions.cover_hidden: a moderator hid your story’s cover.

reportOutcomes.removed: we checked your report {{reference}} and removed what you reported.
reportOutcomes.acted: we checked your report {{reference}} and took action.
reportOutcomes.no_action: we checked your report {{reference}}. It doesn’t break our rules or the law, so we left it up.

appealOutcomes.open: your appeal {{reference}} is waiting for a moderator.
appealOutcomes.upheld: a different moderator looked at your appeal {{reference}} again. The decision stands.
appealOutcomes.overturned: a different moderator looked at your appeal {{reference}} again and changed the decision.

emailSettings.heading: Notifications
emailSettings.intro: Choose what we email you. Everything still shows up in the app.

kinds.new_chapter: New chapters in stories I follow

emailSettings.saveFailed: We couldn’t save that. Check your connection and try again.
emailSettings.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your email choices. Check your connection and try again.
emailSettings.digestNote: The daily digest arrives once a day, in the morning, and only when something happened.
emailSettings.noMarketing: We don’t send promotional emails to anyone under 18.
emailSettings.unsubscribeNote: Every email except account, safety and legal ones has a one-click unsubscribe link.

unsubscribe.heading: Stop notification emails
unsubscribe.intro: This turns off every notification email we send you: replies, new chapters, comments and new followers. Emails about your account, safety and legal matters still arrive.
unsubscribe.done: Done. We won’t send you notification emails any more. You can turn them back on in Settings.
unsubscribe.unknown: This link doesn’t work any more. Log in and change your emails in Settings.
unsubscribe.failed: We couldn’t do that. Check your connection and try again.
unsubscribe.missingKey: This link is missing its key. Open the link from the email again.
